## Summary

Adds the current Sepo preview URL to agent-authored PR status comments for quick reference.

- `post-comment` now looks up the latest `Sepo preview: ...` PR comment and passes the URL into response formatting.
- Fix-pr status comments include the preview URL and explicitly note that it redeploys automatically after each push; successful fix runs say the update should appear there shortly.
- Review synthesis headers also include the preview URL when available.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm --prefix .agent test`
- [x] `git diff --check`
title: Add preview links to agent PR comments
